final: WITH matched_sentiment AS (SELECT s.transref, s.shortintrt, s.optvolrt, t.ordertypedist FROM sentimentandfundamentals s INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg), baseline_by_ordertype AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(shortintrt) as baseline_shortintrt FROM matched_sentiment WHERE shortintrt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ordertypedist), trans_averages AS (SELECT ms.transref, ms.ordertypedist, AVG(ms.shortintrt) as avg_shortintrt, AVG(ms.optvolrt) as avg_optvolrt FROM matched_sentiment ms GROUP BY ms.transref, ms.ordertypedist) SELECT ta.transref, ta.ordertypedist, ta.avg_shortintrt, ta.avg_optvolrt, CASE WHEN ta.avg_shortintrt IS NULL OR bb.baseline_shortintrt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ta.avg_shortintrt / bb.baseline_shortintrt END as ratio FROM trans_averages ta LEFT JOIN baseline_by_ordertype bb ON ta.ordertypedist = bb.ordertypedist ORDER BY CASE WHEN (ta.avg_shortintrt IS NULL OR bb.baseline_shortintrt IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN (ta.avg_shortintrt IS NULL OR bb.baseline_shortintrt IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE ta.avg_shortintrt / bb.baseline_shortintrt END DESC LIMIT 10
